From c473bcdd80d4ab2ae79a7a509a6712818366e32a Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Arnd Bergmann <arnd@arndb.de>
Date: Thu, 28 Mar 2024 15:30:44 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] nilfs2: fix out-of-range warning

clang-14 points out that v_size is always smaller than a 64KB
page size if that is configured by the CPU architecture:

fs/nilfs2/ioctl.c:63:19: error: result of comparison of constant 65536 with expression of type '__u16' (aka 'unsigned short') is always false [-Werror,-Wtautological-constant-out-of-range-compare]
        if (argv->v_size > PAGE_SIZE)
            ~~~~~~~~~~~~ ^ ~~~~~~~~~

This is ok, so just shut up that warning with a cast.

Signed-off-by: Arnd Bergmann <arnd@arndb.de>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20240328143051.1069575-7-arnd@kernel.org
Fixes: 3358b4aaa84f ("nilfs2: fix problems of memory allocation in ioctl")
Acked-by: Ryusuke Konishi <konishi.ryusuke@gmail.com>
Reviewed-by: Justin Stitt <justinstitt@google.com>
Signed-off-by: Christian Brauner <brauner@kernel.org>

diff --git a/fs/nilfs2/ioctl.c b/fs/nilfs2/ioctl.c
index f1a01c191cf5..8be471ce4f19 100644
--- a/fs/nilfs2/ioctl.c
+++ b/fs/nilfs2/ioctl.c
@@ -60,7 +60,7 @@ static int nilfs_ioctl_wrap_copy(struct the_nilfs *nilfs,
 	if (argv->v_nmembs == 0)
 		return 0;
 
-	if (argv->v_size > PAGE_SIZE)
+	if ((size_t)argv->v_size > PAGE_SIZE)
 		return -EINVAL;
 
 	/*
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `fs/nilfs2/ioctl.c`**
- The comparison in the conditional statement was modified from:
  ```c
  if (argv->v_size > PAGE_SIZE)
  ```
  to:
  ```c
  if ((size_t)argv->v_size > PAGE_SIZE)
  ```
  This change involves casting `argv->v_size` to `size_t` to suppress a compiler warning regarding a comparison between a constant (65536) and an expression of type `__u16` (unsigned short), which is always false if `PAGE_SIZE` is greater than 65536.

### Relationships
- The modification addresses a specific compiler warning identified by clang-14, which indicated that the original comparison would always evaluate to false due to type limitations. By casting `argv->v_size` to `size_t`, the code now correctly handles the comparison without generating a warning, ensuring that the logic remains intact while adhering to type safety. This change is part of a broader effort to fix memory allocation issues in the `nilfs2` filesystem, as indicated by the referenced commit in the patch.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
if (argv->v_size > PAGE_SIZE)
```
Reason:
The comparison between `argv->v_size` (of type `__u16`) and `PAGE_SIZE` (which can be greater than 65536) is always false if the page size is configured to be greater than 64KB. This results in a compiler warning about a tautological constant out-of-range comparison, indicating that the logic may not behave as intended.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
if ((size_t)argv->v_size > PAGE_SIZE)
```
Reason:
By casting `argv->v_size` to `size_t`, the comparison is made valid regardless of the size of `PAGE_SIZE`. This ensures that the comparison is performed correctly, preventing the compiler warning and allowing the logic to function as intended across different CPU architectures.
